key_insight: HSE made exact exchange practical in extended materials through short-range screening, substantially improving band-gap predictions over conventional semilocal approximations.
engineering_relevance: More reliable band gaps support first-principles materials research for photovoltaics, power electronics, defects, and quantum technologies.
method: Retain short-range exact exchange while screening it away at long range.
Trace HSE03–HSE06 development and the inherited one-quarter exchange fraction.
Compare semilocal and hybrid contenders across accuracy, cost, and transferability.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved gaps for ordinary semiconductors and selected metal oxides, and HSE06-level accuracy from recent meta-GGAs on selected semiconductors, without numerical benchmark results.
watch_item: Fixed screening limits adaptability across electronic environments; this is a density-functional theory perspective, not an AI solar-cell study.
paper_title: Perspective: The HSE Screened Hybrid and the Band Gap Problem: Origins, Impact, and the Contenders
